stories.title: settle by Trestle — Thisispaper

stories.title: First ‘Take It Down Act’ Sentencing Puts Man Behind Bars for 15 Years
stories.sum: James Strahler was sentenced to 15 years in prison for “cybercrimes that included both real and AI-generated sexually explicit images and threats of violence to numerous victims.”
